title: Exercise 5 Starter: The Host Bridge
description: The starter commands for the fifth exercise, which shows that localhost fails inside a container but host.docker.internal reaches the host.

steps.description: Start an interactive Ubuntu container and remove it on exit. The comment says the next lines run inside it.
Install `curl` inside the container with `apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl`.
`curl http://localhost:8001` targets the container's own loopback, so the comment says it should fail.
`curl http://host.docker.internal:8001` targets your host machine, so the comment says it should succeed. The page says the only thing that changed was the hostname.
